packet.title: Functions and declarations (implementation)
packet.summary: Lowers xsl:function, attribute sets, xsl:decimal-format, source whitespace stripping, xsl:global-context-item, xsl:context-item and xsl:initial-template, with global initializers ordered through called components.

body.p: After . Owns src/xslt_lower_declaration.c, tests/xslt_declaration_test.c. xsl:function (visibility, new-each-time, cache), attribute sets (use-attribute-sets, XTSE0720), xsl:decimal-format (2.9), xsl:strip-space and preserve-space for sources, xsl:global-context-item, xsl:context-item, xsl:initial-template. Done when decl-function, attribute-set, strip-space, global-context-item, context-item, misc-initial-template ≥ 85%. Done 2026-10-17 (): src/xslt_lower_declaration.c, src/xslt_whitespace.c, tests/xslt_declaration_test.c; hooks in src/xslt_lower.c, src/xslt_lower_construct.c, the document preparation of src/processor.c; on 4.7's globals, initializers before the templates are released and the order through called components. Scratch harness: function 98/124, attribute-set 47/49, strip-space 25/26, global-context-item 10/12, context-item 29/32, misc-initial-template 2/4 (4 skipped: initial-template parameters), param 31/31, variable 90/108. Character maps are 4.13's; memoization (cache) not done.
